model.title: A bill to authorize additional funding for the San Joaquin River Restoration Settlement Act.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Alex Padilla (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would increase the amount of federal money authorized for the San Joaquin River Restoration Settlement Act, raising the authorized funding from $250,000,000 to $750,000,000 in two places in that law. It would also raise the authorized funding for improvements to the Friant Division, which is part of the same water project, from $50,000,000 to $75,000,000.
